statement: Proposed, unverified average four-sum energy bound for randomized norm-one-torus Elligator bases: draft predicts average C less than 25W0 at actual Curve25519 parameters using a multiquadratic-cover and map-degree argument. The geometric argument, planted-to-uniform bridge, novelty, full formalization and solver-cost consequences require review. No breakthrough, changed exponent or verified geometric theorem is claimed.
